messages:
sam: Heads-up — opened a PR that combines KMS key rotation plumbing + audit-log schema tweak. Need security + infra eyes before we merge. It's blocking a Dedicated customer rollout. PR: #4321.

sam: Diffs include: terraform/kms_bindings.tf, services/key-rotator/rotate.go, observability/audit/events.proto. Mostly small but a couple infra IAM changes.

sam: CI is failing on the integ test for service account perms; I think I missed a binding. Can someone take a look when you have a minute? @anna @maria @lex

ci-bot: Build failed — integration-tests (linux) in PR #4321. See https://ci.internal/4321

anna: Looking now. Quick note: we need an explicit migration plan for existing keys — who will run rollover and when. Also add an entry in the audit runbook.

maria: Re: CI failure — test logs show permission denied on KMS decrypt: 
```
error: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = CloudKMS decrypt failed: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rlr/cryptoKeys/primary: caller does not have permission
```
I think the service-account binding needs the roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter role on the key resource.

sam: Thanks — sending a small TF change in a follow-up commit to add the binding.

lex: For rollout, I'd prefer a gradual switch with tombstone flag in the key-rotator so we can fall back quickly. Also schedule merge in the 02:00-04:00 UTC window to minimize traffic impact.

sam: Good call, I'll add feature flag and set the default to off.

anna: After the feature flag + TF fix, I can re-review and give LGTM from sec side. Please include a short PR description that lists the rollback steps.

maria: Terraform snippet that should fix the binding (pushed as commit 3): 
```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "rotator_binding" {
  crypto_key_id = var.rotation_key_id
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  members       = ["serviceAccount:rotator@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```

sam: Pushed the snippet, added a `--gradual` flag implementation in rotate.go, and updated PR description with rollback steps + runbook link.

ci-bot: Build passed — integration-tests (linux) for PR #4321.

dave: SRE notes: when you flip the flag, do a staged canary across 5% of requests for 30m. If error rate stays <0.5% continue to 25% for 1h, then full. If rollback needed: set flag back to off and re-run rotator with `--force-revert`. Runbook snippet to recover KV cache: 
```
# clear rotator cache on prod nodes
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/key-rotator
kubectl -n prod exec -it deploy/key-rotator -- /bin/sh -c "rm -rf /var/cache/rotator/*"
```

sam: Thanks for the canary steps. I'll coordinate the deploy window and ping SLO channel.

anna: I'm happy to do the final sec approval once the canary config is in and tests are green. I also want an auditlog note that records the key change and who approved it.

lex: I'll own infra approval after SRE confirms the canary monitoring hooks are wired (Tracing + logs + alert).

sam: All set — tests green, canary config in PR, runbook linked. Please review + approve when you can. :rocket:

anna: Reviewing now. Left two tiny nit comments about error text and a log level. Will mark LGTM after those.

maria: Verified TF apply in staging and KMS decrypt test passes. +1 from infra-testing.

anna: LGTM from security.

lex: Approved from infra after SRE verification.

sam: Merging now — will start canary at 02:15 UTC per plan and update thread with results. Thanks all! :heart:
